# Pulpcare Dental Clinic

> Trusted general, cosmetic and emergency dental care in Surulere, Lagos, Nigeria. Led by Dr. Chris and a certified team offering veneers, orthodontics, clear aligners, root canal treatment, and family dentistry.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Pulpcare Dental Clinic services, location and booking.
- [About](/about): Our story, team, values and clinical approach.
- [Services](/services): Full list of dental services offered.
- [Book Appointment](/book-appointment): Book a visit online.
- [Blog](/blog): Dental health tips and articles.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, WhatsApp and clinic hours.

## Services

- [General Dentistry](/services/general-dentistry): Check-ups, fillings, X-rays and preventive care.
- [Dental Cleaning](/services/dental-cleaning): Professional scaling and polishing.
- [Tooth Extraction](/services/tooth-extraction): Painless tooth removal with modern anaesthesia.
- [Teeth Whitening](/services/teeth-whitening): In-office professional whitening.
- [Paediatric Dentistry](/services/paediatric-dentistry): Gentle care for children.
- [Root Canal Treatment](/services/root-canal): Pain-free endodontic therapy.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Veneers, bonding, orthodontics and clear aligners.
- [Emergency Dental Care](/services/emergency-dental-care): Same-day urgent dental attention.
